title: John Harbaugh: Jaxson Dart can live in a lot of different worlds offensively

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: John Harbaugh: Jaxson Dart can live in a lot of different worlds offensively
sources.description: John Harbaugh coached Lamar Jackson to a pair of MVPs in Baltimore, but the duo couldn't find a way to navigate through the playoffs to a Super Bowl before Harbaugh was dismissed after the 2025 season.
